verification: Static source/AST/data inspection only; no tests, compiler, typecheck, inference, product execution or image-quality acceptance performed.

cases.title: Overall is an atomic simultaneous set of thigh/calf, never a stored third strength
cases.procedure: Drag overall, adjust split values, reopen controls, set overall again; verify exact two-value recipe and no doubled displacement

cases.title: Signed actual thigh deformation
cases.procedure: On accepted visible source, negative widens and positive narrows hip-to-knee contour; knees/hips remain fixed

cases.title: Signed actual calf deformation
cases.procedure: On accepted visible source, negative widens and positive narrows knee-to-ankle contour; knees/ankles remain fixed

cases.title: Neutral import and bit-exact identity
cases.procedure: Import/analyse/select and leave defaults; no native load for neutral, no pixels or portable amounts changed

cases.title: Exact actual33/model/source evidence
cases.procedure: Verify real installed Full float16/1 bytes, input pixel digest, full33-point digest and BodyRef; reject any mutated evidence

cases.title: Visible support not bone-centre width
cases.procedure: Start with no contour data; require all 24 reviewed widths and four falloff radii, no inferred defaults

cases.title: Skirt/occlusion/overlap refusal
cases.procedure: Use permitted real sources with covered contours, crossed or overlapping legs; explicit unavailable reason and zero applied effect

cases.title: Low confidence/cropped critical joints
cases.procedure: User confirmation must not upgrade low scores or out-of-frame hip/knee/ankle; retain request as unapplied

cases.title: Strong foreshortening/ambiguous pose refusal
cases.procedure: Exercise large depth/projected-length ratio, sharply bent legs and fixed other joint inside support; refuse without clamping

cases.title: Source support provenance and reanalysis
cases.procedure: Edit pose/source/revision or supply shoulder review to leg operation; refuse stale support and require leg-specific re-review

cases.title: Immutable support/history
cases.procedure: Change support twice, undo/redo; both immutable assets remain and exact prior pointers/reviews restored; no other operation overwritten

cases.title: Canonical people/BodyRef ownership
cases.procedure: Change person graph without relying only on association counter; stale commands/history/transfer refuse; no nearest face guessed

cases.title: Multi-person support refusal
cases.procedure: Include active/inactive nearby bodies/faces; conservative support cannot bend another person under silent priority

cases.title: C2 endpoints/outside support
cases.procedure: Numerically inspect actual joint points, off-grid boundaries and independent exterior points; unchanged outside, smooth endpoint taper

cases.title: Analytical and final Jacobians
cases.procedure: Compare native Jacobian to finite difference and exercise final common-map cell/band-seam gates; report refusals, not quality acceptance

cases.title: Same-BodyRef shoulder plus leg composition
cases.procedure: Combine nonneutral shoulder/thigh/calf with one BodyRef; one BodyGeometry in explicit v2 order, no duplicate body entries or independent grid addition

cases.title: Stale prepared field rejection
cases.procedure: Change recipe/review/support/association after preparing a leg field; input_binding_sha256 mismatch must block preview/export

cases.title: RGB8/16 and aligned masks/deltas
cases.procedure: At preview and original export compare common source map for RGB8/16, semantic/recovery masks and local deltas; exactly one source sampling pass

cases.title: Proxy/original recomputation
cases.procedure: Different preview/original dimensions rebuild all native fields; never enlarge proxy correction; source orientation normalized exactly once

cases.title: Budget/native missing refusal
cases.procedure: Exhaust admitted memory/receipt budget, remove or mismatch optional native core; exact blockers and no Python/image fallback

cases.title: Cross-photo amount-only transfer
cases.procedure: Confirmed anonymous person on both photos with target re-review; transfer exactly two amounts, never coordinates/masks/review; target prepared before publish

cases.title: Project/order round-trip
cases.procedure: Save/reopen active and undo/redo trees; verify one body bank, assets, versioned operation order and old reader capability refusal

cases.title: Unknown active operation refusal
cases.procedure: Preserve unknown future operation data through load/save, but refuse rendering enabled unsupported consumers rather than silently export partial state

cases.title: Slider repeated/cancelled gestures
cases.procedure: One inflight plus latest unsent edit; pointer cancel/blur and keyboard input preserve correct bases; overall does not add intensity

cases.title: Photo/selection/analysis switch race
cases.procedure: Switch source/BodyRef/analysis while request pending; discard unsent old intent and prevent late result from replacing current view

cases.title: Lost reply/query-only reconciliation
cases.procedure: Drop mutation response after commit; exact request receipt retained; query status without replay or duplicate history

cases.title: Original-image review race
cases.procedure: Change original URL/source before load, fail load or mismatched natural dimensions; disable contour capture until exact matching original loaded

cases.title: Actual publication receipt
cases.procedure: Prepared map alone cannot be marked rendered; verify actual published frame/pixel/map hashes, source, dtype, dimensions and one sample

cases.title: Naturalness and background review
cases.procedure: Use varied permitted real visible legs/clothing/background lines; inspect full-res edges, texture, joints and background bending; human visual judgment required

cases.title: No out-of-scope shape changes
cases.procedure: Verify no length/height/head-waist control, no demographic dependence, no hidden anatomy synthesis, and no model download/install on import

cases.title: Neutral leg installation retains v1 shoulder geometry identity
cases.procedure: Create shoulder-only colour masks, open leg editor, select/review/insert neutral leg; geometry identity and mask readiness remain unchanged. Active leg switches to explicit v2; undo/disable returns v1 without relabelling old snapshots.

cases.title: Canonical v14 history and uncertain publication
cases.procedure: Edit legs after hair+shoulder+face edits, coalesce gesture, undo/redo/save/reopen. Drop notifications after publication and query original request; no duplicate mutation, second stack, lost hair input or replay across epochs.

cases.title: Honest thumbnail correspondence and ALIGN=8 decode
cases.procedure: Review legs on odd original dimensions using canonical ALIGN=8 decoder proxy and bounded PNG. Verify original/decoded/display dimensions, normalized coordinates, source stamp checks and refusal of cropped/stale/fake full-resolution receipt.

cases.title: Full owned inputs and all export paths
cases.procedure: Combine active hair, shoulder, legs, face, recovery and late reference/semantic colour. Inspect proxy plus original RGB8/16 export through each full-size consumer. Hair/source assets and decode stamps remain checked; all geometry uses one common sampler.

cases.title: Mismatched publication is not notification uncertainty
cases.procedure: Inject an authoritative returned frame/map/order mismatch after publication; leg validation remains explicitly unresolved and status must not upgrade it from the generic success ledger. A genuine post-publication notification loss may reconcile without replay.
